result:
I've finished T-DG6-FE-AB, and every acceptance check passes on the final tree. My changes are uncommitted for you to integrate. I updated the existing handback in place (`docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-FE-A-frontend-ux-engineer.md`) and marked every change from this continuation **[FE-AB]**. All new logs are in the existing evidence folder, prefixed `fe-ab-`.

**Reviewing the earlier run's work**
- **Client checked against the contract:** I compared all 30 slice E/F/J/C operations in `api/p6.ts` with `docs/api/openapi.yaml`. Paths, methods, required query parameters, cursor paging, the fixed value lists and the deep-link token pattern all match. Nav entries, placeholder routes and problem texts follow §E/F.12 and §J/C.13.
- **One gap, fixed:** §E/F.12 requires the Arabic to be "labelled provisional in the catalogue comments". The earlier run labelled it only in a test-file header. That header also wrongly suggested the ADR-0053/0054 Arabic was final, though both ADRs mark it provisional. JSON files can't hold comments, so:
  - the label is now a list in a new file beside the catalogues, `apps/web/src/i18n/provisional-ar-p6.ts`, with a one-line pointer in `i18n/index.ts`;
  - a new test in `problems-p6.test.ts` fails if a P6 Arabic text is missing from the list, or if its recorded source (ADR or FE-A) disagrees with the ADR tables.
- **Integration never finished before:** the earlier run's integration log stops mid-file, cut off by the restart. Its handback had left that row as TBD, so there was never a result. I kept the old logs as provenance and labelled my results as the ones that count.
- **Re-sweep of planned/unavailable texts:** found one more text to recheck later. `workflowsP5.digestHint` says digests are "in-app"; it may need changing when BE-I2 ships email. It's not my file, so it's listed for its owner.

**Checks run (all exit 0)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `validate --historical --stage DG5` | PASS |
| `pnpm -r typecheck` | passed |
| `pnpm -r build` | passed |
| `pnpm lint` | passed |
| prettier `--check` (rerun after the last edit) | passed |
| `pnpm openapi:lint` | 876 operations, unchanged |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset and `C.UTF-8` (identical counts) | unit-node 2398; unit-web 1768 (one more than the earlier run: my new test); unit-formula-nocodegen 259 + 2 skipped |
| `pnpm test:integration` | 322 files: 3113 passed, 1 skipped |
| P6 e2e, en and ar | 18 passed; slowest test 4.4 s under load, so the default 30 s budget is kept |

- **Skipped tests:** they come from existing conditional skips in DG5/formula test files, not from my work.
- **No failures:** there were no failures, retries or timeouts.
- **Unchanged:** no operations routed, pinned counts unchanged; no migration, no contract change, no new dependency.

**Screenshots:** 18 fresh ones in `T-DG6-FE-A-evidence/screenshots-fe-ab/{en,ar}/`, kept separate from the earlier run's. I looked at the Arabic Sensitive grants page (right-to-left, active entry marked, provisional wordmark) and the English navigation with its seven new entries. The interaction checks I ran are in the e2e: sign-in, clicking each entry, `aria-current`, page direction, axe scan, and confirming no P6 API request is sent.

**Still open**
- The FE-A shell work for slices A, B, D, G, H, I and K, once their contracts exist.
- The FE-B screens behind the 16 "Not available yet" placeholders.
- Items needing other owners, listed in handback §5 and §6:
  - the server navigation catalogue;
  - the web permissions mirror;
  - problem `params`;
  - the evidence upload hint.
- A Mobily language review of the provisional Arabic.

Run time was 21:44:11 to 23:26:48 UTC (103 minutes). Leave the untracked dotfiles at the worktree root (`.bashrc` and similar) out of the merge; they're environment files, not part of this work.
